items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: Myself, Kit Howard, Joey Avery, and Isaiah Robertson on trombone... And I used to play alto with the band

ctx.x: Well, they had Landry. Rodgers was the manager of that band. Myself, Kit Howard, Joey Avery, and Isaiah Robertson on trombone, Joey Avery on trombone. And they had a fellow by the name of White, used to play sousaphone. And they had another fellow, Trapp, used to play at mellophone. And Sam Big Tillman playing bass and I used to play alto with the band, alto sax. And Georgia Lewis was in that band also. He used to play that band.
